translation.ADDON_CASH_WALLET_AND_REFUNDS_DESCRIPTIO: Our Cash Wallet offers a secure, convenient way for customers to manage funds and transact on your platform.
translation.ADDON_CASH_WALLET_AND_REFUNDS_FULL_DESCR: Our Cash Wallet feature revolutionizes how customers manage funds within your platform, offering a secure and convenient way to conduct transactions.nFrom swift payments to comprehensive financial control, enhance the shopping journey with the added flexibility of a Cash Wallet. nPlus, facilitate hassle-free refunds directly to customers' wallets, encouraging future purchases on your platform.
translation.ADDON_CATERING_DESCRIPTION: Our Catering feature simplifies the intricacies of catering services, offering a streamlined solution for both pickup and delivery options.
translation.ADDON_CATERING_FULL_DESCRIPTION: Our Catering feature simplifies the intricacies of catering services, offering a streamlined solution for both pickup and delivery options. nWith customizable menus, preparation times, and delivery windows, you can offer a tailored and efficient catering experience. nThis comprehensive system ensures your business meets customer expectations with ease, from advanced booking to order fulfillment.
translation.ADDON_DELIVERY_COMPANIES_DESCRIPTION: Optimize your delivery operations by incorporating third-party delivery services.
translation.ADDON_DELIVERY_COMPANIES_FULL_DESCRIPTIO: Optimize your delivery operations by incorporating third-party delivery services such as DoorDash Drive, DoorDash Classic, Rappi, Glovo, Wolt, Lalamove, and Uber Direct into your platform. nOur system is engineered to seamlessly connect with new endpoints, facilitating quick and efficient integration. Tailor the delivery process to your business needs, from setting specific rules for when to use third-party services to manual company selection for individual orders.
translation.ADDON_GIFT_CARDS_DESCRIPTION: Introduce the ultimate convenience in gifting with Ordering Gift Cards.
translation.ADDON_GIFT_CARDS_FULL_DESCRIPTION: Introduce the ultimate convenience in gifting with Ordering Gift Cards. Perfect for any occasion, from birthdays to holidays, our versatile gift cards offer your customers a thoughtful way to show they care. nEnable easy purchase and redemption through your platform, bolstering customer satisfaction and loyalty. nWith e-gift card options, adapt to the modern gifting trend and provide a seamless experience for givers and receivers alike.
translation.ADDON_MULTI_BUSINESS_CHECKOUT_DESCRIPTIO: Introduce a seamless multi-store ordering experience with our Multi-Business Checkout feature.
translation.ADDON_MULTI_BUSINESS_CHECKOUT_FULL_DESCR: Introduce a seamless multi-store ordering experience with our Multi-Business Checkout feature. Allow customers to effortlessly combine purchases from groceries, multiple restaurants, and other providers into a single transaction. nThis innovative approach streamlines the checkout process, enhances order management, and offers versatile purchasing options, making it easier for customers to shop across different businesses simultaneously.
translation.ADDON_POINT_WALLET_AND_LEVELS_DESCRIPTIO: Introducing a customizable Loyalty Points & Levels system designed to enrich your customer relationships and incentivize repeat business.
translation.ADDON_POINT_WALLET_AND_LEVELS_FULL_DESCR: Introducing a customizable Loyalty Points & Levels system designed to enrich your customer relationships and incentivize repeat business. nBy rewarding purchases with points and recognizing customer loyalty through tiered levels, you create a compelling win-win scenario.nTailor the program with store-specific rules, currency values, and unique benefits, crafting an engaging loyalty experience that mirrors global best practices like the Starbucks star system.
translation.ADDON_PURCHASED_INFO: Not all current subscriptions are active
translation.ADDON_STRIPE_CONNECT_DESCRIPTION: Stripe Connect transforms how payments are managed within your marketplace.
translation.ADDON_STRIPE_CONNECT_FULL_DESCRIPTION: Stripe Connect transforms how payments are managed within your marketplace, enabling automatic splits between your business and your stores. nThis powerful integration not only simplifies the transaction process but also aligns with your specific contractual agreements, offering a seamless solution for distributing fees and revenues. nSet up in less than 24 hours, this feature requires only your Stripe account to get started.
translation.ADDON_WHITE_LABEL_DESCRIPTION: Embrace full brand autonomy with our Advanced White-labeled Bundle.
translation.ADDON_WHITE_LABEL_FULL_DESCRIPTION: Embrace full brand autonomy with our Advanced White-labeled Bundle. This comprehensive package removes all traces of Ordering+, allowing your marketplace to shine under your exclusive brand.nLeverage our multimillion-dollar technology investment to become an unstoppable force in the marketplace sector, all without worrying about the underlying tech. n Transform your marketplace with our white-labeled solution, combining the power of our technology with the unique identity of your brand. This is your opportunity to stand out and scale up, backed by the most advanced no-code platform for marketplaces.

translation.ADDON_WHITE_LABELED_DASHBOARD_APP_FULL_D: The White-labeled Dashboard offers a comprehensive view of your business under your brand. From order management to data analysis, control every aspect of your platform with ease and style.
